name: 西游记451
english_description: Journey to the West, part of the ES II mudlib family (version 4.50). Its registration flow has no explicit "new character" keyword — entering an English ID that isn't already on file goes straight to "Creating a new character named X — are you sure? (y/n)". Talent points aren't allocated by adjusting slots but through a reroll loop: "Do you accept these talent values? [n|y|q]" — n rerolls, y accepts, and q presumably abandons character creation.
